Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews

Great universities never stand still. They must take the lead as society’s engines of innovation and change, and St Andrews needs to be at the forefront of this.

Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews aims to raise £300 million to achieve this ambition through the key projects below.

With your support, we can make waves and shape the future not only of our University, but of our world.

Campaign priorities

Discover the key projects in our Making Waves campaign.

'New College'
Digital Nexus building
Endowed Chairs and lectureships
Scholarships

More projects

Support Making Waves: The Campaign for St Andrews and help enhance our status as a world-leading, diverse, digital, sustainable and entrepreneurial centre of learning, teaching and research.

  • Enable world-leading medical and interdisciplinary research at St Andrews
  • Translate entrepreneurial ideas into innovative solutions by supporting Entrepreneurial St Andrews
  • The University is committed to sustainability and achieving net zero by 2035. Support Our Sustainable Future
  • Give your support to sport at St Andrews, including performance sport, clubs and facilities.

All donations to the University of St Andrews support the Making Waves Campaign.
